items.prompt: The supplied parser uses data=sys.stdin.read().split(); s=data[0]. Its input bytes are exactly b"aaabb", with no final newline. After running the complete function and printing its joined line, what appears?

options.why: Whitespace splitting does not remove the final character of a token when no newline is present.

options.text: No line, because split requires a trailing newline.
options.why: split() returns a final nonempty token at end of input; it does not require a terminator.
The entire token aaabb is preserved, so the two adjacent runs have lengths 3 and 2.

options.text: a3 b2\n plus an empty run token
options.why: A missing newline does not create an extra character or an empty run; output formatting adds only its normal line ending.

items.explanation: The entire token aaabb is preserved, so the two adjacent runs have lengths 3 and 2.
